description.zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the container cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of container clusters.

description.zh:
容器检索字段。取值：

- **CONTAINER_ID**：容器ID。
- **IMAGE**：镜像名称。
- **NAMESPACE**：命名空间。
- **NODE_NAME**：节点名称。
- **POD_IP**：pod地址。
- **HOST_IP**：主机地址。
- **INSTANCE_ID**：实例ID。
description.en:
The name of the field that is used to search for the container. Valid values:

*   **CONTAINER_ID**: the ID of the container
*   **IMAGE**: the name of the image
*   **NAMESPACE**: the namespace
*   **NODE_NAME**: the name of the node
*   **POD_IP**: the IP address of the pod
*   **HOST_IP**: the IP address of the host
*   **INSTANCE_ID**: the ID of the instance
The value of the field that is used to search for the container.

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~130972~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset group.

> You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~130972~~) operation to query the IDs of asset groups.

description.zh:
是否存在风险。取值：

- **1**：有风险。
- **0**：无风险。
description.en:
Specifies whether risks were detected. Valid values:

*   **1**: yes
*   **0**: no

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh: 执行基线检查的服务器的名称。
description.en: The name of the server on which the baseline check is performed.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的服务器信息的数量。默认值为**10**，表示每页显示10条服务器信息，最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 entries of server information are displayed on each page. A maximum of 100 entries can be returned per page.

description.zh:
风险项的ID。

> 您可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取风险项ID。
description.en:
The ID of the risk item.

> You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of risk items.
The source IP address of the request.
The ID of the baseline check policy.

description.zh:
查询类型。取值：

- **containerId**：容器ID
- **uuid**：资产ID
description.en:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:

*   **containerId**: the ID of the container
*   **uuid**: the UUID of the asset

description.zh: 执行基线检查的服务器ID。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The UUID of the server on which the baseline check is performed. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

title.zh: 查询执行了基线检查的服务器的信息
